_note: The retail NPC dialog window (NpcHtmlMessage). Interface.xdat declares no such window -- it is a native class, and every value here is an inline immediate at the address it names. Re-verify with --check.

align.evidence: NWindow.dll 0x1034ed30 -- the five alignment keywords, h then v.

colorRule.evidence: NWindow.dll NCHtmlObject::GetMatchedColor 0x100825d0 -- null guard 0x10082609, wide compare against 0x1024dd44 L"LEVEL" returning the immediate at 0x10082653, concatenation onto 0x1024dd38 L"0xff" at 0x1008269d, and the base-16 parse (push 0x10 / push 0 / push ebx / call 0x101c3629) at 0x10082705. Byte order is ARGB because the one named colour's own immediate 0xffffcc00 is retail's gold level tint.
colorRule.rule: GetMatchedColor(s): s == NULL -> 0; wcscmp(s, L"LEVEL") == 0 -> 0xffffcc00; else wcstoul(L"0xff" + s, NULL, 16).

colors.evidence: NWindow.dll 0x100856fa push 0xffdcdcdc (body text, the not-a-link branch), 0x100856a3 mov eax,0xff6699ff (link text, taken when the anchor's own GetMatchedColor result is 0) with the same value pushed again at 0x100856c9, and 0x10082653 mov eax,0xffffcc00 (NCHtmlObject::GetMatchedColor's only named colour).

entitiesEvidence: NWindow.dll 0x1034ec10 -- a flat sorted array of 67 wide names, the client's complete named-entity set. `apos` and `copy` are NOT in it, so ' and © stay literal. No numeric-reference (&#nn;) path was located, and the shipped datapack uses none.
tagsEvidence: NWindow.dll 0x1034e9a8 -- 51 sorted 12-byte records {const wchar_t* name, const wchar_t** attrs, int attrCount}. This is the complete element-name table of the client's HTML parser; a name absent from it is the UNKNOWN case.

window.evidence: NWindow.dll 0x1013fde7 and 0x1013fec5 -- both NCNPCHtmlViewer instances (alloc 0x1d4, the size its own deleting dtor frees at 0x100899ef; ctor 0x10089fd0 writes vtable 0x1024ef7c) call SetWindowRect (vtable slot 0xc0, body 0x1005e8f0) with push 0x191 (h) / push 0x136 (w) / anchored=1 hMode=0 vMode=5, y = parentHeight * 0.5 - 252 from the doubles at 0x1022f270/0x1027ddd8. Interior from NCNPCHtmlViewer::OnCreate 0x1008a030: title bar (0,0,W,20) at 0x1008a0d7, html frame (7,30,W-14,H-37) at 0x1008a1c1/0x1008a16d with the doubles at 0x1024f730/0x1024f738. Background control built at 0x1013fe74 and stored over OnCreate's own L2UI.etcwnd.NPCHtml_BACK at 0x1013fe86.

openAnim.evidence: NWindow.dll 0x10089ae8 -- NCHtmlViewer's constructor loads L2UI_CH3.npcwnd.npc1_back_alpha01 through NCObject::LoadTexture (0x1003f630, which returns a UTexture* and builds no control) and stores it at this+0x250 (0x10089af4). A byte scan of the whole image for that displacement finds the store and nothing else inside 0x10080000..0x1008b000, and `npc1_back_alpha` occurs in NWindow.dll only -- not in NWindow.u, Interface.u, Interface.xdat, UWindow.u, Window.dll or Engine.u. The 22 frames are a wipe as art; this client never draws them, so a port that animates them would be inventing one.

title.evidence: NWindow.dll 0x1013fe65 and 0x1013ff43 -- both NCNPCHtmlViewer instances get `push 444` into vtable slot 0x164, which is NCWnd::SetWindowTitle(int) at 0x10059b30 (its own assert string sits at 0x102443b0): the body reads the frame control at this+0xc0 -- the (0,0,W,20) title bar -- and forwards the int to NCFrameCtrl::InsertTitle(int) 0x1001af50, which assigns L"" to this+0x2d8 and the int to this+0x2e4. So the title is a SysString ID. `fromPageTitle` is false because NO slot-0x164 call site exists anywhere in 0x10080000..0x1008b000, the html viewer's own code -- a page's <title> cannot reach the bar. The id space is confirmed on the other slot-0x164 sites in the same image: 149 'Log In', 598 'Lineage II User Agreement', 472 'Petition - GM', 999 'Lineage 2 Messenger (Alt+Y)', 449 'Choose Server', 857 'Server Selection Information'.
